content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to link my emergency stop input with this program but can't figure out how to connect it. If I delete the input, the branches are also removed. I want my emergency stop from another program to activate this one as well.
Sorry, I don't quite understand your question or your screenshot. The screenshot only indicates you're using the input multiple times.

How can I insert a block between I2 and the branches? The screenshot shows the current setup. I have another program and control panel, and I want to network the emergency stop from my new panel and program with this one. Thank you.
I must repeat, your question is still unclear to me.
Try using a digital network output.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble integrating an emergency stop input from a new control panel and program into an existing logic application. The main challenge is inserting a network output block between an existing input and its branches without removing the current logic. There are communication difficulties among users, suggesting possible interface or documentation issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to easily add a networked emergency stop input from a new panel into the existing program, without affecting the established logic or disconnecting branches.
